published_title: Tarkin  your fingers are leaking again
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Sparky''') posted a [[Light]] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.

starting.card: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

description: This is one deck you can't judge by the top card.  Aliens, numbers, retrieval, and some drains all combine.  It's unexpected, and that's why it works.  Just don't go to 10 tournies in a row with it.
cards: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers
posted: Never Tell Me The Odds x5
posted: Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes x2
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 5': Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (posted 'Hidden Base/Tarkin's butterfingers'), Rendezvous Point, 'Hidden Base Indicator', The Signal and Bargaining Table; they count toward the total. Bargaining Table is the only Effect in the starting section, so it is marked as the starting Effect.
Posted 'Hidden Base/Tarkin's butterfingers' is the Hidden Base objective (a joke on its back side, Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers).
Posted 'Hidden Base Indicator' is kept as written (UNKNOWN): it is the face-down planet system the objective places to mark the 'Hidden Base', and the post names none.
The posted section headers add up to 61 (5+9+12+9+6+8+12) and the list totals 61 as published. Header 'Weapons/Devices 6' is not a card.
This is a Light deck (Hidden Base); the draft had it as Dark.

Posted 'Suprise Assult' dested the Light Premiere Surprise Assault (the strategy uses it with high destiny); the draft had the Dark Counter Surprise Assault. 'The Signal' and 'Bargaining Table' dested those cards (the draft had Twi'lek Advisor and Den Of Thieves).

Posted 'Coruscant' dested Coruscant (Light) (Special Edition), the only Light Coruscant system before the Coruscant set; 'Kiffex' the Light Kiffex (Jabba's Palace); 'Chandrilla' Chandrila; 'Lando in Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon; 'Control/Tunnel Vision' Control & Tunnel Vision.
Mon Calamari x2 and Kessel x2 are kept as published (unique systems).
The strategy mentions Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice as a good addition, but it is not in the list.
